register_benchmark_decorator: register a benchmark function with optional metadata info in the unibench registry
load_benchmark_by_name: load a benchmark by its name from the unibench benchmarks module with optional kwargs
get_benchmark_info: retrieve metadata info for a registered benchmark by its name
list_available_benchmarks: list all available benchmark names sorted alphabetically across all frameworks
get_benchmark_types: get the list of benchmark framework types registered in the unibench registry
